GP practice has a serious issue with its appointment system. According to their rules, patients must call at 8:00 a.m. to book an appointment. I followed these rules exactly — I started calling right at 8:00 and kept waiting until 8:45. During this time, the automatic system eventually placed me in a queue, but when they called me back, no one spoke, and then the call was suddenly disconnected. When I tried calling again, I was told that there were no appointments available for the day
The same issue happened yesterday as well, which shows that this is not a one-time mistake but a recurring problem. It is extremely frustrating and unfair to patients who genuinely need medical help. People are trying to follow the proper procedure, but the system itself is failing them. The staff do not seem helpful or understanding, and their attitude makes the situation even worse I strongly believe the local NHS officer and the doctors should be informed about this ongoing issue. The GP practice needs to either change its appointment rules or fix the technical and staffing problems that are causing these delays and dropped calls. It is not acceptable for patients to spend nearly an hour calling for help and still not be able to see a doctor If this situation continues, it could put patients’ health and even their lives at risk. Medical care should be accessible and reliable, not something people have to fight for every morning. I would also advise others to be cautious before registering with this GP because right now, it feels like they are not taking their duty to care for patients seriously. The system needs urgent review and improvement before more people suffer due to these ongoing failures.
